eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Two
titlePlain: UPDATE with a WHERE Clause and
subtitle: Lesson 15 · Writing Data

caption: Only rows that are BOTH Red AND priced over 1000 get the discount.

code:
UPDATE d
SET d.ListPrice = p.ListPrice
FROM dbo.LessonDemo AS d
JOIN Production.Product AS p
    ON d.ProductName = p.Name
WHERE p.ProductLine = 'R';
caption: The new value comes from the JOINED table, not a literal or the same row.

code:
UPDATE d
SET d.Color = p.Color
FROM dbo.LessonDemo AS d
JOIN Production.Product AS p
    ON d.ProductName = p.Name;
caption: Unmatched LessonDemo rows are left untouched -- just like an inner join excludes them.

code:
UPDATE d
SET d.ListPrice = p.ListPrice,
    d.Color = p.Color
FROM dbo.LessonDemo AS d
JOIN Production.Product AS p
    ON d.ProductName = p.Name
WHERE p.ListPrice > 500;
caption: ON pairs the rows up; WHERE restricts which matched pairs get updated.

subtitle: Removing rows instead of changing them.
